buddhūpasampadā: [Buddha+upasampadā] (thī) CL=9 The monkhood obtained due to the words of the Buddha.
buddhūpaṭṭhāna: [Buddha+upaṭṭhāna]  CL=9 Standing close to Lord Buddha. Attending the Buddha. Buddhūpaṭṭhāna(na) [buddha+upaṭṭhāna] attending the Buddha. See buddhupaṭhāna.
bujjhakārādhika: [Bujjhakāra+adhika] (ti) CL=9 Additional things to be known.
bujjhamāna: [Budha+ya+māna] (ti) CL=9 1. (a) One who know (b) One who will know (2) The Awaken one, the Buddha.
bujjhana: [Budha+ya+yu]  CL=9 (1) knowing. (mfn.) (2) To know, will know; he. See ñāṇa, bujjhanabhāva.
bujjhanabhāva: [Bujjhana+bhāva] (pu) CL=9 As one who will know; the nature that will be known, the manner that will be known.
bujjhanaka: [Bukha+ya+ṇvu(aka)]  CL=9 [n is inserted. Nirutti, P. 547.](1) one who knows, who will know; he. (2) one who wakes up (form the sleeping of defilements); he. (3) one who experiences; he. (4) one who will know; he. See bujjhanakapaduma.
bujjhanakaaṅga: [Bujjhanaka+aṅga] (pu) CL=9 (1) The mark of one who will know (2) the mark of one who will awaken.
bujjhanakabhāva: [Bujjhanaka+bhāva] (pu) CL=9 As one who will know.
bujjhanakabhāvaparāyaṇa: [Bujjhanakabhāva+parāyaṇa] (ti) CL=0 In the case of a person who knows and will know, he is also a reclining and dependent person. he.
bujjhanakapaduma: [Bujjhanaka+paduma] (na) CL=8 A lotus that will bloom
bujjhanakasatta: [Bujjhanaka+satta] (pu) CL=9 (1) One who will know (2) One who will awaken. See bujjhanakapaduma also.
bujjhanakiriyā: [Bujjhana+kiriyā] (thī) CL=9 The verb of knowing, The manner of knowing.
bujjhanasabhāva: [Bujjhana+sabhāva] (pu) CL=9 The nature that will be known.
bujjhanti: [Budha+ya+anti]  CL=9 (They) know. See bujjhati (1).  bujjhante (passive verb) [budha+ya+ante] are known. See bujjhīyati.
bujjhare: [Budha+ya+anti] (kri) CL=9 (A) They know (Direct meaning). (B) They have known (metaphorical meaning).
bujjhati: [Budha+ya+ti] (kri) CL=0 There are two kinds of bodhichitta: asceticism = kamma, and asceticism = kamma. နိ တိ၊ Dha 230.] (1) I know. He understands by insight. (2) He awakens. (3) He realizes. (4) He opens. bujjhati Bodhisattva (Kamma, Kyi) [Buddha + Ya + Tay] should be known. Bodhisattva - Look.
bujjhesi: [Budha+ya+eyyāsi]  CL=9 should/would know. [yyā is dropped by the great Sutta/aphorism. Nirutti, P-369.] See bujjhati (1).
bujjhissanti: [Budha+ya+ssanti] (kri) CL=8 They will know. See. Bujjhati
bujjhissati: [Budha+ya+ssati]  CL=9 (1) will know. See bujjhati (1). (2) will appear- be enlightened. See bujjhati (4).
bujjhissāma: [Budha+ya+ssāma] (kri) CL=8 We will know. See. Bujjhati
bujjhitabbabuddhavantu: [Bujjhitabbabuddha+vantu] (ti) CL=0 He knows the Dhamma that should be known. he.
bujjhitukāma: [Bujjhituṃ+kamu+ṇa] (ti) CL=8 Wanted to know, one  who wants to know
bujjhiyamāna: [Budha+ya+ya+māna] (ti) CL=8 That should be known, penetrated
buli: King Buli. Assosuṃ kho allakappakā bulayo "bhagavā kira kusinārāyaṃ parinibbuto"ti. Dī, 2. 136.(-137).
bunda: [Vu+da]  CL=9 (a) root, foot, base. (b) bottom of pot. [Budha+a. Vu saṃvaraṇe, do, niggahitāgamo. Budha gamane vā, a, dhassado. Dhāna, ṭī. 549.]
bundikābaddha: [Bunda+ekābaddha]  CL=8 a kind of couch or longchair (with the rails) attached to the feet. [Bundena pādena saha ekābaddhā aṭani yassa so bundikābaddho, ekārassittaṃ. Dhāna, ṭī. 310.]
buñjanabuddhi: [Byañjana+janikā+buddhi]  CL=8 The mind that gives rise to letters - word; Knowledge that gives rise to letter - word; Being clever at words (such as sithila/loose one); ten kinds of words being different due to mind.
buddhadhammasaṅghaguṇapaṭisayutta: [Buddhadhammasaṅghaguṇa+paṭisaṃyutta] (ti) CL=9 Related to the quality of the Buddha, Dhamma and Saṃgha.
buddhadhammasaṅghapaṭisayutta: [Buddhadhammasaṅgha+paṭisaṃyutta] (ti) CL=9 Related to the Buddha, Dhamma and Saṃgha.
buddhaguṇapaṭisayutta: [Buddhaguṇa+paṭisaṃyutta] (ti) CL=8 Connected with the attribute of the Buddha
buddhaguṇasakittaka: [Buddhaguṇa+saṃkittaka] (ti) CL=0 Who speaks well of the Lord. he.
buddhaguṇasakittana: [Buddhaguṇa+saṃkittana] (ti) CL=9 Who speaks well of the quality of the Buddha; one.
buddhaguṇasavaṇṇanā: [Buddhaguṇa+saṃvaṇṇanā] (thī) CL=9 Praise the quality of the Buddha.
buddhaguṇānubhāvasasūcaka: [Buddhaguṇānubhāva+saṃsūcaka] (ti) CL=9 Indicating the virtues and power of the Buddha.
buddhappaṭisayutta: [Buddha+paṭisaṃyutta] (ti) CL=9 Related to- concerned- connected with the Buddha.
buddharasi: [Buddha+raṃsi] (thī) CL=8 Ray of light of the Buddha
buddhavasa: [Buddha+vaṃsa] (pu) CL=0 (1) A book detailing the genealogy of the gods. The Book of Buddhism. Seed of God
buddhavasadesanā: [Buddhavaṃsa+desanā] (thī) CL=9 The speech that shows the lineage of the Buddha.   The sermon of the Buddha"s lineage.
buddhavasadhammakathā: [Buddhavaṃsa+dhammakathā] (thī) CL=9 Dhamma sermon about the Buddha"s lineage.
buddhavasakathā: [Buddhavaṃsa+kathā] (thī) CL=9 The talk that explains extensively the Buddhavaṃsa treatise; Buddhavaṃsaaṭṭhakathā.
buddhavasasavaṇṇanā: [Buddhavaṃsa+saṃvaṇṇanā] (thī) CL=0 The opening of the Buddhist scriptures. The eighth stanza of the Buddha.
buddhavīmasaka: [Buddha+vīmaṃsaka] (ti) CL=9 Investigating the Buddha, whether he is the Buddha or not. He who investigates..
buddhānubhāvapaṭisayutta: [Buddhānubhāva+paṭisaṃyutta] (ti) CL=8 Connected with the power of the Buddha
buddhānubuddhasavaṇṇita: [Buddhānubuddha+saṃvaṇṇita]  CL=9 (1) explained by the disciples who in succession following the Buddha. (2) explained by Lord Buddha and noble disciples.
buddhānussatisavaṇṇanā: [Buddhānussati+saṃvaṇṇanā] (thī) CL=8 The definition of the word Buddhānussati
